name: litellm-cost-budget
description: Test 3 on LiteLLM v1.103.2: a hard dollar budget, one request at a time. Run with the t3-budget key (max_budget $0.0002; README.md). Each Claude request costs about $0.00003 and reserves about $0.00015 up front; expect about 6 through, then 429 "Budget has been exceeded" with no model call. x-litellm-key-spend shows the spend after each request; the final spend can pass the budget by at most one request.
